rationale: The round-2 exchange has clarified the real trade-off and even identified a plausible deep-rationalisation/no-closure pathway, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and the state still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management and investors still require durable structural savings. Positions have hardened around a narrow compromise space, so further unconstrained rounds are likely to repeat the same contested points without producing a breakthrough.
